I had my 12-year-old cat groomed there. She had always been refused service due to her reactivity towards strangers, even though she'd been groomed since she was 4 months old.

The service I received was quick and efficient, and they were very considerate of my cat's emotions. They didn't refuse the grooming appointment and were open to discussing the matter with us and working with us; this surprised me because often, groomers refuse service after the first visit, out of fear of my cat and her reactions, which, without the proper tools, can injure the groomers.

In short, it was a very pleasant experience for both us and our anxious cat, whose emergency grooming took a maximum of 10 minutes. Perfect service for animals that are almost impossible to groom, except under anesthesia (an option not available to us given her age). The price was also affordable, we were greeted with a smile at reception, and we left without feeling judged because of our grumpy cat.

In short, I recommend it and I will continue to go there for my cats and dogs! 😊🤎
